Hi Alex 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can lock down a dedicated capacity recommendation: 

Summary from our discovery:
- Primary use: customer-facing chat (multi-turn) + a small async batch rerank job.
- Preferred model family: open Llama-3 variants (you mentioned a preference for a 70B-ish model).
- Data need: company-only data, must run in dedicated pool (no shared-hosted API).

Questions we need answers to for a sizing estimate: 
1) Peak TPS (inference requests per second) you expect at launch and projected in 6 months (ballpark)
2) Typical concurrency per user session (how many concurrent tokens/requests per session) or desired concurrency target for the service
3) Token mix: avg prompt tokens and avg response tokens, and % of requests that are short (<=50 tokens) vs long (>500 tokens)
4) Latency SLO (p95/p99 target)  is sub-200ms p95 required?
5) Preferred GPU constraints (if any): e.g., H100 vs A100 vs other, or purely cost-driven
6) Timeline for procurement & go-live (helps with capacity planning)

Proposed next steps:
- If you can reply with the items above, Rafael (cc'd) will draft an initial capacity plan (options: latency-optimized vs cost-optimized) and a short workbook with expected throughput/costs.
- We can schedule a 30-45m sizing call with Rafael and our infra SEs if you want a deeper walkthrough.

Thanks  I want to make sure our recommendation maps to your procurement timeline.

Best,

Marissa  thanks for the recap. Sorry for the delayed reply, I pulled answers together with the engineering team: 

Answers to your questions:
1) Peak TPS: today our beta averages ~40 TPS; target for GA is 250 TPS peak. We expect ~10-15% growth in 6 months.
2) Concurrency: we want the platform to support ~32 concurrent user inference requests across the fleet (not per-GPU concurrency). Sessions are short-lived, but we need headroom for spikes.
3) Token mix: average prompt ~25 tokens, average response ~220 tokens. Distribution: ~75% short-ish (<=200 tokens), ~25% long responses (300-800 tokens).
4) Latency SLO: p95 target ~350ms would be acceptable for now; p99 target is less strict but prefer <1s. We don't need sub-200ms unless there are cost-effective options.
5) GPU preference: procurement will push for A100 to control costs unless H100 gives a clear latency advantage for our chosen model. We are open to your recommendation.
6) Timeline: procurement aims to finalize by end of Q2 2026; earliest go-live mid-Q3. Procurement contact: procurement@finserve.com.

We are leaning toward dedicated capacity (we need data isolation and predictable throughput). Please send options (latency vs cost) and a short worksheet so I can take to finance/procurement.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of AI Products | FinServe

Alex  perfect, this is exactly what we need. High-level guidance based on those numbers: 

Preliminary recommendation (ballpark):
- For 250 TPS peak and 32 concurrent sessions, we typically size two classes of options:
  Option A (latency-optimized): 8x H100 GPUs in a dedicated pool running Llama-3-70B or equivalent. Expected p95 ~200-350ms depending on sequence length; higher perf for shorter responses.
  Option B (cost-optimized): 16x A100 GPUs (larger aggregate capacity, slightly higher p95)  good when you want lower $/token but can accept higher latency tail.

Notes/assumptions:
- Estimates assume batching and prefix caching for repeated prompts.
- Token mix you provided maps to moderate KV-cache usage; long tails (25% longer responses) will increase GPU utilization during peak windows.
- We will include a headroom buffer (~20%) for spikes and autoscaling rules.

Next steps:
1) Rafael will put together a short workbook (attached spreadsheet) that shows expected throughput, estimated token costs, and a recommended GPU config for both options.
2) Schedule a 30-45m technical sizing call this week so Rafael can walk the Eng + Procure team through networking, IAM, and service isolation requirements for Dedicated.

Would Thursday 3/19 10:00-10:45am PT work for a joint call? If not, suggest two windows.

I'll mark this as 'dedicated' in our internal opp and loop in pricing for a firm estimate once we agree on the option.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Dedicated sizing estimate (options + assumptions)

Alex / Marissa  attaching a short workbook (dedicated-sizing-estimate.xlsx) and a networking checklist so procurement/security can review. Quick notes from my side: 

Assumptions used in the workbook:
- Model baseline: Llama-3-70B-ish optimized weights (FP16/quant-friendly).
- Avg tokens/req: 245 (25 prompt + 220 response).
- Peak TPS: 250; concurrency target: 32 across service.
- Effective tokens/sec per H100 (est): ~40k tokens/sec (model and sequence dependent). A100 per-device tokens/sec is roughly ~65-75% of the H100 number for this workload.

Sizing math (simple):
- Req tokens/sec = TPS * avg_tokens = 250 * 245 = 61,250 tokens/sec.
- H100 devices needed (tokens/sec / per-device) = 61,250 / 40,000  1.53 -> after accounting for batching overhead & headroom, we recommend 4-6 H100s for steady state + autoscale for spikes (8x H100 is latency-optimized to keep p95 lower and support headroom).
- A100 path: per-device ~30k tokens/sec -> 61,250 / 30,000  2.04 -> recommend 12-16 A100s; 16x A100 gives similar steady-state capacity to 8x H100 but with slightly higher latency tail.

Concurrency guidance:
- The 32 concurrency target you mentioned is at the service level. On a per-device basis, concurrency depends on batching and max sequence length; both options above include batching policies tuned to prioritize latency for interactive traffic.

Network / infra notes:
- Dedicated requires private networking and a peered VPC. See attached networking_checklist.pdf for firewall rules, egress controls, and NAT/route table items procurement/security will want.
- If you need VPC-only access (no public endpoints) we can provide a Private deployment in your VPC; that will change procurement and timeline slightly.

Cost vs latency trade-offs (quick):
- 8x H100: higher $/month, lower p95 latency. Good if user experience is critical and finance is ok with premium.
- 16x A100: lower $/month, higher latency tail. Better if cost per token is primary constraint.

Next actions I recommend:
1) Confirm whether procurement prefers the A100 cost-first path or H100 latency-first path.
2) If you want, we can run a short perf test (2-3 days) on a trial dedicated pool using a representative prompt set to produce a validated workbook. We'll need ~5-10k sample requests and a test key.
3) Schedule the technical call (Marissa suggested 3/19 10:00 PT) -> Rafael will lead the sizing review and address networking/IAM questions.

Attachments: dedicated-sizing-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), networking_checklist.pdf

Thanks  happy to jump on the call and walk through the sheet line-by-line.
